_about: Events behind /events/. Rule: no event is published without a credible, named source. verificationStatus 'verified' needs sourceUrl + lastVerified and is the only state that produces Event structured data; 'reported' is shown with a visible 'awaiting official confirmation' flag and produces no structured data. price: null means not confirmed (never assume free).

events.title: Simhastha Kumbh Mela opens — flag-hoisting (dhwajarohan)
events.location: Ramkund, Nashik and Kushavarta Tirtha, Trimbakeshwar
events.description: The Mela is reported to open with a flag-hoisting ceremony at Ramkund in Nashik and at Kushavarta Tirtha in Trimbakeshwar. Timings and any restrictions around the ceremony have not been confirmed.
